meta.regression_evidence: All seven archived inputs were rerun against an audit-owned exact-source copy (28+28+41+21+28+56+28 assertions). Two fresh exact-source inputs checked read-N consistency, trailing-deletion parity, padded-CIGAR refusal, and the shipped self-test.

scientific_integrity.detail: Claims are grounded in labelled synthetic fixtures, real alignment slices, and observed tool behavior.

practice_boundaries.detail: No clinical inference; production callers are named for out-of-scope cases.

methodological_ground.detail: BAQ, flags, depth caps, read-N handling, and text-pileup parity were re-executed.

code_usability.detail: The CLI and deterministic self-test run; helpers match samtools on archived and fresh fixtures.

functional_suitability.note: Text pileup, pysam helpers, and modern bcftools calling routes are complete and tested.

reliability.note: Read-N denominators agree, trailing deletions cannot crash the renderer, and padded CIGARs fail clearly.

performance_context.note: The main guide is now 361 lines and reusable code lives in importable examples.

agent_usability.note: Version checks, option mappings, recipes, and error boundaries are explicit.

human_usability.note: Natural prompts remain and point to focused helpers.

security.note: No credentials, network mutation, or unsafe path handling is introduced.

maintainability.note: Helpers are shipped once and covered by a deterministic temporary-fixture self-test.

agent_specific.note: Tool choice, deprecations, scope limits, and stop conditions are clear.
